title: Normal house that gets crazier as you go up to the higher floors
content: I just had this dream this morning. There was this house sort of similar to the picture that looked a bit more like an older Victorian house that was fairly close to the ones next to it. I went to the backyard and it opened up and there was a wide grassy area and a gradually sloping hill that lead down about 75 feet to a dog park surrounded by a wooded area. I found this out by asking one of the many workers who were doing landscaping and repairs. I went into the back door and it was a fairly standard old house. I go up a couple flights of stairs and then I see a set of narrow stairs right against the wall with a narrow ledge that you had to walk on to get on the stairs. If you weren't careful, you'd fall off of it down the previous flight of stairs. I climb up and the next floor looks similar to an art gallery, with random sculptures and, strangely, multiple holes in the floor of various sizes. The pictures don't quite do it justice. There were also large holes with no railings that you could fall off down to the previous floor. The floor itself felt very unstable, like it wasn't supported and would slightly bend as I walked and could fall in at any moment. I spoke to a woman about this who was on that level and she said I could walk back down these unsupported wooden spiral stairs that weren't attached to anything. Look up the original "Loretto stairs" without the railing to get an idea. I decided against this and went up the most rickety stairs yet. The next floor was completely different. It reminded me of the frutiger aero style with chrome walls and fake grass and play areas. There was an smooth single curving escalator that I started riding up. I then had the thought "am I dreaming? No...this is too realistic to be a dream." Right at that time, my alarm went off. Has anyone else experienced a similar house?
